title: Srikanth beats world No. 8 Naraoka for first time; Lakshya Sen also in Kumamoto last eight
dek: Both Indian men won their round-of-16 matches at the Super 500 event in Japan. Sen needs points to qualify for the World Tour Finals.
author: Declaration Desk
body:
Kidambi Srikanth beat Japan's fifth seed and world No. 8 Kodai Naraoka 21-15, 11-21, 21-18 on Thursday to reach the quarter-finals of the Kumamoto Masters Japan, a BWF Super 500 tournament. It was Srikanth's first win over Naraoka in five meetings. The 33-year-old, now ranked 31, had saved two match points in a 24-22 deciding game against Denmark's Rasmus Gemke in the previous round on Wednesday.

Lakshya Sen, the eighth seed and world No. 13, beat China's Dong Tian Yao 21-8, 21-14 in 35 minutes. He plays Japan's Yushi Tanaka in the quarter-finals on Friday; Sen has won both their previous meetings, including the 2025 Australian Open final. Srikanth faces Japan's Koki Watanabe, ranked 15.

The tournament matters for Sen, who is 10th in the race for the eight places at the BWF World Tour Finals in December, according to the standings reported this week. PV Sindhu has already qualified.

India's women's doubles pair Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand lost 14-21, 14-21 to third seeds Rin Iwanaga and Kie Nakanishi. The semi-finals are on Saturday and the finals on Sunday, 15 November.
